Method of Attack: Exploitation of vulnerabilities in Accellion FTA servers to gain unauthorized access
Use of zero-day vulnerabilities and new vulnerabilities to breach systems
Ransomware attack with ransom note demanding bitcoin payment
Data exfiltration and publication of stolen sensitive data
Impacted Systems: Flagstar Bank's Accellion file transfer server
Other Accellion clients including Singtel, Bombardier, QIMR Berghofer, Washington's State Auditor office, New Zealand Reserve Bank, NSW for Transport, Fugro, Jones Day, Danaher, ABS Group
Attack Vector: Exploitation of vulnerabilities in Accellion FTA file sharing platform
Unauthorized access via Accellion FTA server
Indicators of Compromise: Screenshots of stolen data published by Clop ransomware gang
Security advisories and disclosures by Flagstar Bank and Accellion
